data.author: implement
data.comment:
Root cause: the no-op guard in import()/upsertItems() compares the optional needsProducerReview flag with strict equality. The store persists an omitted flag as 0 and reads it back as false, so an incoming record that omits the field (undefined) compared against stored false was counted as a semantic change and bumped updatedAt — re-timestamping every unchanged item on re-import. Regression introduced by WL-0MVAPEZTE005T27J (e950d006) which re-added needsProducerReview to the compared field set after WL-0MV85WFYU0071YQ9 removed it, without treating omitted == false.

Fix (packages/shared/src/database.ts compareTrackedFields): compare needsProducerReview as a boolean (Boolean() coercion) so an omitted flag equals false; genuine false->true flips still count as changes. Added 3 regression tests in packages/shared/src/database.test.ts (import + upsert omission, plus a flip-detection guard).

Note: also resolves sibling test-failure items WL-0MVB9557U009LEIF and WL-0MVB95Q1H0060MZ6 (same describe block, same root cause) — full tests/database.test.ts (232 tests) passes with the fix.
